run_hierarchical_clustering: run the prep_hrchy script to perform fine and coarse hierarchical KMeans clustering on feature files
run_cluster_fine: run cluster_fine to perform online balanced KMeans clustering on a sample of feature files with cosine or euclidean distance
run_cluster_coarse: run cluster_coarse to cluster fine-grained centers into coarse clusters and save assignments
refactor_cluster_fine: refactor cluster_fine to support configurable sampling rates instead of the hardcoded 5 percent sample
review_cluster_coarse: review cluster_coarse to verify it correctly loads fine centers and predicts coarse cluster assignments
